col_1: Are declared file or directory outputs reached through an intermediate symlink followed so the real content is captured?
col_5: A tests path.isFile() and path.isDirectory(), which follow symlinks, after ruling out the missing case with exists(Symlinks.NOFOLLOW), so a file or directory reached through an intervening link has its digest or listing captured.

The non-following isSymbolicLink() is reserved for declared symlinks. I read the body at lines 137-151 of SpawnLogContext.java in B's transcript.
